triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “Most pious and holy elder,” he cried, pointing to Ivan, “that is my son, flesh of my flesh, the dearest of my flesh!

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Smerdyakov, the valet sent me by my father, in reply to my inquiries, told me twice over that the appointment was for one.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: as well as of the violent anger to which he had been roused in his quarrels with his father.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: while Dmitri Fyodorovitch is in debt to me, and not a little, but some thousands of which I have documentary proof.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: You have been blaming me, Pyotr Alexandrovitch, you have!” he turned suddenly to Miüsov, although the latter was not dreaming of interrupting him.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Dmitri Fyodorovitch,” yelled Fyodor Pavlovitch suddenly, in an unnatural voice, “if you were not my son I would challenge you this instant to a duel

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Shameless hypocrite!” exclaimed Dmitri furiously. “He says that to his father! his father!

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: You wanted to put me in prison because you are jealous of me with her, because you’d begun to force your attentions upon her;

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: she should take I.O.U.’s of mine which were in your possession, and should sue me for the money so as to get me into prison by means of them

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “I said it on purpose to madden you, because you always disclaim the relationship, though you really are a relation in spite of your shuffling.

triples.subject: Pyotr Alexandrovitch Miüsov
triples.quote: “I am not your relative and never have been, you contemptible man!”

triples.subject: Miüsov
triples.quote: Miüsov looked with hatred at Ivan. “Here he is, going to the dinner as though nothing had happened,” he thought.
